excluded_capture.reason: Recovery status UI change interrupted tool execution; fresh AX geometry verified and capture restarted. Additional warmup before reuse-1; excluded from comparative results.

decision: Retain one-time redundant release presentation removal. Pointer-up ranges do not overlap (baseline 17.224-18.597ms, reuse 4.098-7.220ms); presented sample population changes, so no physical display latency/FPS claim.
scope_notes: 820 measured CUA drags; baseline 410, reuse 410. 5 trials per variant >=60s active operation each, split into two >=30s blocks; tool gaps excluded from active-operation duration.
6 alternating process groups, not 5 fresh processes per mode. Initial drags and inter-trial round trips excluded from capture. reuse-1 also had an interrupted ~30s extra warmup, preserved separately.
Owned compile/test/Clippy work ended before capture. Other applications remain open; this is not an isolated laboratory benchmark.
AX checks follow every drag. Every block ends at X=8.031mm; last move undone and fixture saved back to X=3.528mm.
Presentation samples change from 1230 to 820. Pointer-up stages remain one per measured drag and corroborate shorter handler blocking. Durations are inclusive, not additive.
Old markers can persist into a later input group; first/latest values retained separately. Captures represent presented input groups, not one mouse event per presentation.
Physical input, OS queue, display photons, stylus pressure and other platforms excluded. Text/multiple-selection checks are correctness checks, not sustained latency measurements.
